request.text:
# Infographic request: harness

- For: the studio programme, experiment E11, part two. Not a beat of the talk; the talk is frozen.
- One sentence the audience must understand: a boundary the agent cannot widen is one the kernel was told about before the tool started, by something the agent's grant does not include.
- The data, and where it comes from: only src/static/studio/data/harness.json: the six hello probes under a deny-all policy (one read allowed; a write outside the workspace, a TCP connect and a wrong hash refused; the workspace write; the memory cap), the five environments, the status labels and the seven components.
- The sequence, in SHarness's own order: write the policy (files, ports, memory, processes; anything not named is denied); hash it (the hash is its name); the kernel enforces it before the tool starts; the probes run; six of six held.
- The researcher's cautions, which the slide must keep: six of six held on 25 October 2026 (not "24 to 29 October"); five environments on two kernels, all uid 0 (say five environments, not five platforms); the components are running as MVPs (fs, net), runnable (policy hash, check, translate) or designed (kms, bash, llm); the launcher above the agent is designed, with a first slice (sharness-ai shell) running since 28 October. sharness.ai is the editor's own project and every run is its own: no third-party report yet. And the caveat the site itself makes: a process cannot bind its own session; only a launcher above the agent makes the policy a boundary for the agent.
- What moves, if you know: connect it to E09's last line, "12 of 12 excess with no control". Show one row of that excess (for example "reach any host on the internet") meeting a policy the kernel holds: the connect refused. Then the six probes, one by one, each held. End on the honest caveat, so the room sees what is measured and what is still designed.
- Length: 40 to 60 seconds; must read as a still at the end.
- Needed by: your next free slot.
- What it must not say: never that the agent is contained today (the launcher is designed); no "platforms"; no number not in the file; nothing measured that is designed.

As before: label the drawing itself, plain words first, text clear of the headline at the end, and the piece at ruv-sgit/harness/index.html with its explainer beside it.
